Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 19

“Even here, rebirth is conquered by those whose mind is established in evenness. Brahman is flawless and the same, and so they are established in Brahman.”

The logic is elegant: since the absolute is uniform, a mind that has become uniform is already in it. Sameness of vision is the state itself, not a virtue rewarded later.
